# DKR-022: No dangerous added capabilities

- **Group:** Docker
- **Severity when it fails:** high
- **Root:** the full result needs `sudo`. Without root this check may report `unknown`; it never reports a pass it could not verify.

## Why it matters

SYS_ADMIN, SYS_PTRACE, SYS_MODULE and ALL each give a container a path to the host kernel or other processes. NET_ADMIN and NET_RAW let it change the network stack or forge packets, which matters on a shared network.

## Verify by hand

```sh
docker inspect --format '{{.Name}} {{.HostConfig.CapAdd}}' $(docker ps -aq)
```

## How to fix it

Use cap_drop: [ALL] and add back the minimum the container needs; replace SYS_ADMIN with the specific mount or device it was added for.

## What a fix can break

Features that used the capability (VPN clients, packet capture, FUSE mounts) stop working.

Run `stackward explain DKR-022` for the same text in your terminal. [All checks](index.md).
